title: Hit-aware token-aligned replay oracle for cache-induced divergence detection
creator: Ava Martínez
description: Motivation: KV/prefix cache hits have been observed to change downstream token sequences in subtle ways that standard end-to-end diffs miss. We need a deterministic, token-aligned replay oracle that can isolate cache-hit-conditioned divergences, attribute them to config or model changes, and produce gating signals for canary rollouts. Goal: build a reproducible harness that replays a diverse request corpus with cache-enabled and cache-disabled runtimes, aligns token streams at the sub-token level, computes confidence-weighted divergence scores, and surfaces routable alerts and canary-gate thresholds for the console and CI pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can replay 50k historical requests with both cache-enabled and cache-disabled modes deterministically
Token-level alignment produced for >95% of responses (measured by alignment coverage across byte-pair tokens)
Divergence scorer outputs per-request and aggregated metrics (token edit distance, probability-shift-weighted divergence, first-diff-position distribution)
Canary gating rule produced: block rollout if median probability-weighted divergence > 0.08 on top-10% hit-conditioned requests
Integration with console: per-model/per-config dashboard and an automated alert when divergence crosses configured thresholds
steps: Define representative replay corpus: sample by traffic slice, prompt templates, failure-prone customers
Instrument logger to capture model logits, tokenization boundaries, cache hit metadata and KV signatures
Implement deterministic replay runner that replays each request with identical RNG seeds, request ordering, and KV cache preconditioning
Build token-aligner that maps sub-token boundaries and produces stable alignment even with early-stopping or top-p truncation
Design divergence scorer: combine token edit distance, per-token log-prob shift, and first-diff position weighting
Create aggregator and exposure layer: per-request metadata, hit/non-hit stratification, histogram exports to Console metrics
Add canary hook: compute pass/fail by workspace/model/config and wire into rollout pipeline
Run internal alpha on 5k requests and validate against manually curated golden set
